props.name: addressSource
props.comment: The form field holding the address text.

props.name: height
props.comment: In pixels, or any CSS length. Defaults to 400.

props.name: latSource
props.comment: The form field holding the latitude.

props.name: lngSource
props.comment: The form field holding the longitude.

props.name: provider
props.comment: Defaults to the `geocoder` of `MapsProvider`. One of the two is required.

props.name: zoom
props.comment: Read once at mount. Defaults to 13.
